svg.title: A civic map points into the pond while the resident stands at the nearby doorway.
svg.desc: A large blank map substrate confidently marks the pond as the address. The occupied doorway and resident are plainly beside it; Babul notes that the map found the pond, and Riju sees everyone else was misplaced.
svg.text: Page 33, panel 2 · Front medium shot of a large civic map beside the resident's doorway

text.tspan: The official map places the household in the pond
while the household stands beside it.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
